implementation: ARROW response dipoles with ARROW smeared electrostatic dipole-cloud ESP
response_definition: unchanged cloud dipole (cloudQ*ClShft) of complex minus solute/environment solves
esp_operator: dipole point operator multiplied by Q(rho)=1-exp(-rho)*[c0*(1+rho)+(c1-c2)*rho^2+c2*rho^3], rho=r/wESd
cloud_nucleus_coefficients: read per atom type from cw_cn_c0,cw_cn_c1,cw_cn_c2
probe_points: copied from source arrow prediction files
